title: BloodCraft
description: An mod at adds vampires, an new dimention, and more!
body:
This is an vampire mod at adds the ability to become an vamipre, go to an new dimention, get an new block set!

- Ability to become an vampire
- New flesh dimention
- New flesh block set and vain block set

The core part of this mod is the flesh dimention, you can go to the flesh dimention by going to the nether and finding the flesh biome, and making and portal out of flesh blocks and lighting it with the Flesh Igniter!

(Find the recipes with jei or nei or go to the gallery tab!)
